title: Terraform baseline: VPC, EKS, node groups, RDS, Redis, S3, KMS
acceptance_criteria: terraform apply from zero produces a working empty environment in a fresh AWS account; api, agent, and render node groups scale independently.

title: Redpanda cluster and topic provisioning as code
acceptance_criteria: All 14 topics plus matching .dlq topics exist with retention read from adjutant-events.json. Topic creation outside Terraform is denied.

title: Schema registry plus CI backward-compatibility gate
acceptance_criteria: A PR that removes a payload field or narrows a type without bumping event_version fails CI. Adding an optional field passes.

title: CI/CD with expand/contract migration gate
acceptance_criteria: A migration that drops or renames a column in the same release as its code change is rejected by CI.

title: OpenTelemetry pipeline to Grafana/Tempo/Loki/Mimir
acceptance_criteria: A single request produces one connected trace across core-api, orchestrator, and one adapter.

title: Span attribute contract enforcement
acceptance_criteria: Any span missing brand_id, or any model/channel call span missing usd_cost, fails the contract test.

title: Apply schema and run the invariant suite in CI
acceptance_criteria: adjutant-schema.sql loads clean and all 14 invariant tests fail closed on every pipeline run. A regression blocks merge.

title: Temporal cluster, namespace per environment, worker versioning
acceptance_criteria: A worker deploy mid-workflow does not break in-flight executions; replay test passes against recorded histories.

title: KMS CMK, per-tenant DEK provisioning, rotation runbook
acceptance_criteria: A database dump without KMS access yields no usable channel credential. Rotation is executed once in staging end to end.

title: Service scaffold template
acceptance_criteria: A new service is generated with otel, tenant-context middleware, healthz, and a passing test suite in under 10 minutes.

title: Internal gRPC transport with tenant and trace metadata propagation
acceptance_criteria: A call without tenant metadata is rejected with TenantContextMissing at the interceptor, before any handler runs.

title: Local dev environment
acceptance_criteria: One command brings up Postgres, Redis, Redpanda, and Temporal with seeded fixtures.

title: Event envelope library (Python and TypeScript)
acceptance_criteria: Publish validates against the registry; consume dedupes on event_id and routes validation failures to the DLQ. Both languages share the conformance fixtures.

title: event_outbox table and relay service
acceptance_criteria: No service publishes directly. Relay claims with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, and a kill -9 between publish and mark produces a duplicate that the consumer dedupes rather than a lost event.

title: Consumer registry manifest and CI registration check
acceptance_criteria: A service that subscribes to a topic without a manifest entry fails CI.

title: DLQ inspection and replay tooling
acceptance_criteria: An operator can view, filter, and selectively replay DLQ messages with the original envelope intact.

title: Load-test harness for governor and deployment fan-out
acceptance_criteria: Harness simulates 500 brands deploying simultaneously and reports governor queue behavior and 429 count.

title: Tenant context injection on connection checkout
acceptance_criteria: A pooled connection returned without tenant context can read zero rows from every brand-scoped table.

title: Cross-tenant leak suite on every migration
acceptance_criteria: Every migration runs the leak suite; a new table without RLS fails the build.

title: AuthN (OIDC) and the full role matrix
acceptance_criteria: All seven roles enforced at the API boundary with a table-driven test per role per endpoint.

title: Agency-to-client role scoping
acceptance_criteria: A client_approver can approve only their own brand's subjects and can read nothing else in the agency.

title: S3 prefix isolation with IAM conditions
acceptance_criteria: A credential scoped to one brand prefix cannot list or read another brand's objects.

title: Channel credential encryption with no-log assertions
acceptance_criteria: A test that greps logs, spans, and agent context for a known token value finds zero occurrences.

title: agent-runtime egress lockdown
acceptance_criteria: A NetworkPolicy test confirms agent-runtime pods cannot reach any ad platform host. Capability removed, not denied.

title: Account type mutability without data loss
acceptance_criteria: A business account converts to agency and back with zero row loss and no orphaned brands.

title: Signed immutable audit export
acceptance_criteria: Export is byte-reproducible for a fixed window and carries a verifiable signature.

title: Threat model and pen-test scope for the spend path
acceptance_criteria: Written threat model reviewed and signed off; external pen-test scope covers every path that can reach Build or Mutate.

title: Approval state machine
acceptance_criteria: All transitions and side exits implemented; an illegal transition raises rather than being silently ignored. pending_client without a prior internal approval is impossible.

title: Ed25519 signing via KMS with overlapping-validity rotation
acceptance_criteria: Key rotation completes with zero token-validation failures for tokens signed by the outgoing key.

title: IssueToken: hash binding, scope derivation, cap binding, bounded expiry
acceptance_criteria: Token is issuable only from an approved request; expiry beyond 72h is rejected by the database, not just the service.

title: ValidateToken: Redis-backed, fail-closed
acceptance_criteria: P95 under 15 ms at 1,000 rps. With Redis unavailable, validation denies rather than permits, and the denial is alerted.

title: ConsumeToken single-consumption with write-through
acceptance_criteria: A replay of the same (token, channel, operation, idem_key) is rejected and raises a security alert, not a warning.

title: Token voiding on subject mutation
acceptance_criteria: Editing an approved plan voids every outstanding token in the same transaction and emits plan.voided. Verified by the schema invariant suite.

title: Approver spend-threshold enforcement
acceptance_criteria: A reviewer whose threshold is below the requested daily spend cannot be an eligible approver.

title: Negative security suite for the spend path
acceptance_criteria: Hash mutation, scope escalation, cap overflow, replay, expiry, and cross-brand token use all fail closed. Any regression blocks release.

title: Expiry timers, reminders, abandonment metric
acceptance_criteria: Requests expire on an absolute deadline; reminder cadence configurable; abandonment rate emitted as a metric from day one.

title: Two-stage internal-then-client approval with agency delegation
acceptance_criteria: An agency can require client sign-off per brand; the client stage is unreachable before internal approval.

title: Chaos tests: Redis loss, KMS unavailable, clock skew
acceptance_criteria: Each fault produces a denial and an alert. No fault produces a permitted write.

title: Append-only ledger writer with revert_path capture
acceptance_criteria: Every spend-affecting action writes one row with actor, diff, token id, and a populated revert_path. UPDATE and DELETE are rejected by the database.

title: action.recorded emission from the same transaction
acceptance_criteria: The bus can never disagree with the ledger; a crash after commit still publishes via the outbox.

title: Reversibility engine
acceptance_criteria: Rollback walks revert_path in reverse within the window and verifies each step against the platform.

title: Audit timeline UI
acceptance_criteria: Per-brand chronological view showing actor, action, diff, token, and USD impact, filterable and exportable.

title: Capability Registry loader and versioning
acceptance_criteria: Registry YAML validates against a schema at load; an entry missing a required field fails startup. All 10 channels seeded.

title: Spec Registry loader
acceptance_criteria: Placement specs, safe zones, character limits, and codec constraints are readable by render-svc and the validator. Nothing hard-codes a dimension.

title: ChannelAdapter protocol and adapter registry
acceptance_criteria: A static check fails the build on any channel-name conditional above the adapter layer.

title: Rate-limit governor: Redis and Lua token buckets
acceptance_criteria: Buckets refill per each channel's declared quota_model. Bucket arithmetic is atomic in a single round trip.

title: Governor priority queueing with visible queue position
acceptance_criteria: Deployment outranks optimization outranks backfill. The user sees 'queued behind 3 deployments', not a spinner.

title: write_account_allowlist constraint kind
acceptance_criteria: LinkedIn's development-tier five-account write limit is modeled as a constraint kind rather than as a rate.

title: Idempotency key derivation and read-by-key reconciliation
acceptance_criteria: A create that succeeded behind a 504 is adopted on retry, not duplicated. Verified by an induced-timeout test per adapter.

title: Token assertion at the adapter boundary
acceptance_criteria: Every adapter asserts validity locally before its first outbound HTTP call. A test that removes the caller's check still cannot produce a write.

title: Per-channel change-notification audit
acceptance_criteria: Each channel's registry entry carries mechanism (webhook or polling), poll interval, and the date verified. No code reads a channel name to decide.

title: Webhook ingress
acceptance_criteria: Signature verified before parse; deduped on delivery id; 200 returned under 500 ms; payload treated as a reconcile hint, never as state.

title: Adapter conformance suite (the executable Channel DoD)
acceptance_criteria: One shared suite every adapter must pass: capability accuracy, idempotency under induced timeout, verification catching a silent failure, verbatim rejection capture, quota respect without probing.

title: Cassette record and replay harness
acceptance_criteria: No CI path touches a production ad account. Cassettes are refreshable on demand.

title: Kill switch with verification and paging
acceptance_criteria: Row checked on every egress call; fan-out complete within 60 s; any channel unverified at 5 minutes pages rather than toasts.

title: Structure sync and external-drift detection
acceptance_criteria: Changes made outside Adjutant are detected and surfaced as drift with changed_externally set.

title: Verbatim rejection capture and classification hook
acceptance_criteria: Platform text stored unmodified; classification is a separate derived field that never overwrites the original.

title: Governor observability dashboard
acceptance_criteria: Queue depth, drain estimate, and observed 429 count per channel per ad account.

title: Meta: connect and refresh
epic: ADPT · Meta and Google to full DoD
acceptance_criteria: OAuth and system-user paths both work; token refresh is automatic and a revocation surfaces as connection health within one sync.

title: Meta: read_structure and read_metrics
epic: ADPT · Meta and Google to full DoD
acceptance_criteria: Full hierarchy and hourly metrics land correctly, including restatements of prior windows.

title: Meta: build and asset upload, idempotent
epic: ADPT · Meta and Google to full DoD
acceptance_criteria: Campaign, ad set, and ad created with idem keys; induced timeout on each level reconciles rather than duplicating.

title: Meta: quota model from documented formula
epic: ADPT · Meta and Google to full DoD
acceptance_criteria: Bucket capacity computed as base + 40 x active_ads with tier read from the X-Ad-Account-Usage header; recomputed on every structure sync. Limits are never probed empirically.

title: Meta: verify, rejections, and Advantage+ targeting constraints
epic: ADPT · Meta and Google to full DoD
acceptance_criteria: Read-back verification; rejections captured verbatim; the Strategist cannot plan interest targeting where Advantage+ removes it.

title: Google Ads: connect, refresh, account hierarchy
epic: ADPT · Meta and Google to full DoD
acceptance_criteria: Manager-account hierarchies resolve correctly; a brand can be linked to a single child account unambiguously.

title: Google Ads: read_structure and read_metrics
epic: ADPT · Meta and Google to full DoD
acceptance_criteria: Structure and hourly metrics land, including asset-group-level reporting.

title: Google Ads: Performance Max asset-group build
epic: ADPT · Meta and Google to full DoD
acceptance_criteria: Asset groups respect the 1-to-100-per-campaign bound, are never treated as shareable across campaigns, and always carry at least one final URL.

title: YouTube placements and video asset handling
epic: ADPT · Meta and Google to full DoD
acceptance_criteria: Video assets upload and attach correctly; YouTube-specific placements are declared in the capability registry rather than special-cased.

title: Google: verify, rejections, AI-content label policy
epic: ADPT · Meta and Google to full DoD
acceptance_criteria: Read-back verification; verbatim rejection capture; AI-generated content is labeled per current Google Ads policy on submission.

title: Meta and Google pass the full conformance suite
epic: ADPT · Meta and Google to full DoD
acceptance_criteria: Both adapters green on every conformance test with zero waivers. No channel ships with a waiver.

title: Workers, task queues per pool, versioning strategy
acceptance_criteria: Agent and render pools have separate queues and autoscaling; a mid-flight deploy does not break executions.

title: Retry policy library and non-retryable error registry
acceptance_criteria: All 15 terminal error types are registered non-retryable. A test asserts no Token error is ever retried.

title: Workflow ID conventions with REJECT_DUPLICATE
acceptance_criteria: Starting deploy/{deployment_id} twice is a no-op rather than a double launch.

title: Signal idempotency and stale-hash guard library
acceptance_criteria: A duplicate signal is ignored; a signal whose subject_hash no longer matches is recorded and never acted on.

title: Replay-safety CI test against recorded histories
acceptance_criteria: Any non-deterministic change to workflow code fails CI before it can break in-flight executions.

title: File Meta Advanced Access / App Review
acceptance_criteria: Submitted in week 1 with demo assets and privacy documentation. This is the long pole; nothing waits on engineering to start it.

title: File LinkedIn Standard tier application
acceptance_criteria: Submitted in week 1. Until granted, development tier permits writes on only five ad accounts and one creatable test account, which constrains alpha design-partner selection.

title: TikTok developer app, terms, verification, data-security review
acceptance_criteria: All four steps of the integration path initiated in week 1; data-security review documentation drafted.

title: Pinterest standard access application
acceptance_criteria: Submitted in week 1. Developer guidelines reviewed and the rate-limit-probing prohibition recorded as a build constraint.

title: Snapchat, Reddit, Microsoft, Amazon developer onboarding
acceptance_criteria: Accounts created and access confirmed. Reddit and Snapchat require no allowlisting, so these are the lowest-risk parity wins.

title: Microsoft REST-only posture
acceptance_criteria: The adapter targets REST exclusively from the first line of code, given SOAP's announced deprecation timeline.

title: Access-status tracker and weekly review
acceptance_criteria: Per-channel status, blocker, owner, and contingency reviewed weekly and visible to the whole team.

title: Site ingest and structured extraction
acceptance_criteria: Given a domain, the crawler extracts offerings, pricing signals, geography, and tone candidates with a source URL per field.

title: Assertion writer with provenance enforcement
acceptance_criteria: An assertion cannot be written in confirmed state without a provenance URI. Enforced by the database, verified by the invariant suite.

title: Confidence scoring and low-confidence surfacing
acceptance_criteria: Fields below threshold are ordered for human review; the user is not asked to re-confirm high-confidence extractions.

title: Brand Graph confirmation UI
acceptance_criteria: A user confirms or corrects a draft graph in under 10 minutes for a typical SMB; corrections write with human provenance.

title: Generation gate on unconfirmed graph
acceptance_criteria: CommitSceneGraph raises BrandGraphUnconfirmed when the graph is not confirmed. No bypass exists, including in admin tooling.

title: Palette, typeface, and logo extraction into the brand kit
acceptance_criteria: Extracted palette and typefaces are usable as style_refs; logo is stored as a protected asset that generation may never recreate.

title: Ad account history ingest for warm start
acceptance_criteria: Prior campaign performance informs the first plan rather than starting cold.

title: Brand Graph clone with field-level diff
acceptance_criteria: An agency clones a graph to a similar client and sees a field-level diff before committing.

title: Claim-to-assertion substantiation index
acceptance_criteria: SubstantiateClaims resolves a claim string to a provenanced assertion or returns unresolved. It is a graph lookup, not a model judgment.

title: OnboardBrandWorkflow end to end
acceptance_criteria: Signup to confirmed graph runs as one durable workflow that survives a deploy mid-onboarding and waits up to 14 days for confirmation.

title: Agent bundle definition format
epic: AGENT · Agent runtime and first three agents
acceptance_criteria: Prompt, tool allowlist, model tier, output schema, USD ceiling, and retry policy are declared as data and loaded at startup.

title: Invoke with schema validation and bounded retries
epic: AGENT · Agent runtime and first three agents
acceptance_criteria: Invalid structured output retries up to three times with the error fed back, then raises SchemaValidationExhausted and escalates to a human task. It never degrades to unstructured text.

title: Tool allowlist enforcement at dispatch
epic: AGENT · Agent runtime and first three agents
acceptance_criteria: The Copywriter has no channel-gateway verb; the Optimizer's list contains no write verb. A forged tool call is refused at dispatch.

title: Per-invocation cost metering
epic: AGENT · Agent runtime and first three agents
acceptance_criteria: Every invocation writes agent_run and emits agent.run.completed with model, tokens, latency, USD, and brand attribution.

title: Model tier policy and per-brand generation ceiling
epic: AGENT · Agent runtime and first three agents
acceptance_criteria: Exceeding the monthly ceiling degrades to a cheaper tier and notifies. It never silently burns margin, and never halts without telling anyone.

title: Strategist agent
epic: AGENT · Agent runtime and first three agents
acceptance_criteria: Produces a channel-allocated plan validated against the Capability Registry, with written rationale, for a brand it has never seen.

title: Copywriter agent
epic: AGENT · Agent runtime and first three agents
acceptance_criteria: Copy respects per-field character limits read from the Spec Registry and brand tone from the graph. No truncation occurs downstream.

title: Art Director agent
epic: AGENT · Agent runtime and first three agents
acceptance_criteria: Emits a valid scene graph with distinct visual concepts, never a flat image, and never rasterizes a text layer.

title: Prompt-injection hardening on ingested content
epic: AGENT · Agent runtime and first three agents
acceptance_criteria: Adversarial instructions embedded in a crawled page cannot alter agent behavior. A red-team corpus is part of CI.

title: Agent evaluation harness
epic: AGENT · Agent runtime and first three agents
acceptance_criteria: Golden briefs across four verticals scored on regression; a prompt or model change that degrades quality fails the build.

title: Scene graph schema and validation
epic: CRTV · Scene graph and static render
acceptance_criteria: A graph with a rasterized text layer is rejected at commit with TextLayerRasterized.

title: Scene graph versioning and creative_hash
epic: CRTV · Scene graph and static render
acceptance_criteria: Any mutation produces a new version and a new hash, which voids outstanding approval tokens.

title: Anchor-preserving re-layout engine
epic: CRTV · Scene graph and static render
acceptance_criteria: Anchors resolve against each target ratio's safe zone and text shrinks within its declared range. A layer that cannot fit raises RenditionInfeasible rather than cropping.

title: render-svc static pipeline with font management
epic: CRTV · Scene graph and static render
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic typographic rendering: identical graph and spec always yield identical bytes. Missing font raises rather than substituting silently.

title: Content-addressed render cache
epic: CRTV · Scene graph and static render
acceptance_criteria: Re-render after an unrelated edit is a cache hit. Nine renditions are nine renders of one graph, never nine generations.

title: Rendition validator
epic: CRTV · Scene graph and static render
acceptance_criteria: Programmatic assertions for clipped text, mid-word breaks, contrast below 4.5:1, logo outside safe zone, byte and duration bounds.

title: Infeasible-rendition routing
epic: CRTV · Scene graph and static render
acceptance_criteria: A spec-validation failure routes back to creative revision and cannot enter the approval queue. Reviewers never see a broken rendition.

title: Golden-image diff suite across all nine ratios
epic: CRTV · Scene graph and static render
acceptance_criteria: Every ratio covered; a rendering regression fails CI with a visual diff artifact attached.

title: CreativeSetWorkflow
epic: CRTV · Scene graph and static render
acceptance_criteria: Copy, art, and video agents run in parallel, then render, validate, compliance-check, and wait for approval as one durable execution.

title: App shell, auth, brand switcher, dual-mode navigation
acceptance_criteria: Business and agency modes share one shell; neither is visually or navigationally subordinate.

title: Signup with dual account-type choice
acceptance_criteria: Both account types are presented with equal prominence and equal copy weight. Neither is a default or an upsell.

title: Approval queue list
acceptance_criteria: P95 under 250 ms at 500 pending items. Keyboard-first, batch selection, and sorted by a defensible priority rather than by creation time.

title: Approval detail view
acceptance_criteria: Side-by-side renditions, plan diff against the prior version, compliance findings with citations, and the agent's written rationale on one screen.

title: Bulk approve with per-item exclusion
acceptance_criteria: A reviewer approves 40 creatives and excludes 3 in a single action, and the issued token covers exactly the approved set.

title: Change-request flow with reason codes
acceptance_criteria: Structured reason codes plus free text; both flow into plan.rejected as Strategist training signal.

title: Governor queue position and deployment progress
acceptance_criteria: Per-channel progress with real queue position. No indefinite spinner exists anywhere in the deploy path.

title: Kill switch UI
acceptance_criteria: One action, explicit confirmation, then live per-channel verification status until every channel is confirmed paused.

title: Console accessibility and contrast audit
acceptance_criteria: WCAG AA on the approval path. We cannot enforce 4.5:1 in ads and ship a console that fails it.

title: DeploymentWorkflow with independent per-channel activities
acceptance_criteria: Channels are independent units of success. A TikTok 5xx does not roll back live Meta campaigns.

title: Preflight orchestration
acceptance_criteria: Pixel, conversion action, UTM, landing-page reachability, and billing validated per channel before any spend. A failing channel is blocked while others proceed.

title: Verification read-back with long poll
acceptance_criteria: Liveness is never inferred from a write response. Unverifiable objects mark the channel partial, never live.

title: Retry reconciliation
acceptance_criteria: A retry reusing the same idem key adopts a pre-existing object. Induced-timeout test per level per channel produces zero duplicates.

title: Rollback within window
acceptance_criteria: A launch is fully reversible within 10 minutes across every channel it touched, with each reversal verified.

title: Deployment audit rows
acceptance_criteria: One ledger row per mutation carrying the authorizing token id, the diff, and a revert path.

title: MonitorBrandWorkflow on an hourly schedule
acceptance_criteria: Runs hourly per brand, self-heals a missed cycle, and re-derives rather than depending on event delivery.

title: Metric sync with watermark events
acceptance_criteria: Downstream scans trigger off watermarks, never off wall-clock time. Restatements invalidate derived rollups for the window.

title: Raw metric ingest and partition management
acceptance_criteria: Monthly partitions created ahead of need; raw channel metrics land immutable.

title: Normalization layer with comparability_class
acceptance_criteria: Every normalized metric carries direct, caveated, or first_party_only. No aggregate crosses classes without an annotation.

title: Anomaly detection with significance evidence
acceptance_criteria: Every anomaly carries confidence and sample size so downstream consumers can refuse weak signals.

title: Notification fan-out
acceptance_criteria: Email and in-app delivery with per-user cadence controls and suppression.

title: Performance dashboard
acceptance_criteria: Per-brand, per-channel performance with methodology annotations rendered inline, not hidden in a tooltip.

title: Alpha exit-gate instrumentation
acceptance_criteria: Approval-accept rate, unauthorized-spend counter, and platform disapproval rate are live dashboards before the first design partner onboards.

title: Design partner onboarding runbook
acceptance_criteria: Repeatable path for 6 SMBs and 4 agencies across 4 verticals, sized against LinkedIn's five-account development-tier write limit if Standard tier has not landed.

title: Alpha exit review
acceptance_criteria: Gate: at least 60% approval-accept rate, zero unauthorized-spend events, no more than 5% disapproval rate. A miss delays Phase 2 rather than being waived.

title: TikTok adapter to full DoD
acceptance_criteria: Passes the full conformance suite with zero waivers. Dynamic quota endpoint queried rather than assumed; Spark Ads and batch creative management declared in the registry.

title: LinkedIn adapter to full DoD
acceptance_criteria: Passes the full conformance suite with zero waivers. Access tier recorded on the connection; development tier's five-account write limit enforced as a constraint, not discovered at runtime.

title: Microsoft adapter to full DoD
acceptance_criteria: Passes the full conformance suite with zero waivers. REST only. No SOAP code path exists, given the announced deprecation.

title: Reddit adapter to full DoD
acceptance_criteria: Passes the full conformance suite with zero waivers. conversion_pixel_id required on creation; current objective enum set loaded from the registry.

title: Pinterest adapter to full DoD
acceptance_criteria: Passes the full conformance suite with zero waivers. Rate limits declared from documentation and adjusted only on observed 429 headers. Probing is prohibited and the test suite asserts we never do it.

title: Snapchat adapter to full DoD
acceptance_criteria: Passes the full conformance suite with zero waivers. Ad creation via the documented ad-squad path; no allowlisting needed, so this is an early parity win.

title: Amazon adapter to full DoD
acceptance_criteria: Passes the full conformance suite with zero waivers. Sponsored Products v3 only; v2 is deprecated and no v2 path is written.

title: Channel parity report
acceptance_criteria: Published matrix of conformance results across all nine channels. Any waiver is a release blocker, which is how equal priority stays true.

title: Video scene graph extension
acceptance_criteria: Timeline, audio bed, and caption layers extend the same graph model. Video is not a separate creative system.

title: FFmpeg assembly worker and GPU node-group decision
acceptance_criteria: Resolves open technical question T2/T3 with a measured cost-per-render comparison, not an opinion.

title: Video agent
acceptance_criteria: Script to shotlist to assembly, producing platform-appropriate cuts at every required duration.

title: Captions and burn-in with disclosure support
acceptance_criteria: Captions render typographically; a required AI or paid-partnership disclosure can be placed without violating safe zones.

title: Duration, codec, and bitrate validation
acceptance_criteria: Per-placement bounds read from the Spec Registry; a violation fails validation rather than being submitted and rejected.

title: Video perceptual regression suite
acceptance_criteria: Frame-sampled perceptual diffs catch assembly regressions across every target duration.

title: Optimizer agent, propose-only
acceptance_criteria: Its tool allowlist contains no write verb. A test asserts the Optimizer cannot reach Build or Mutate even with a forged call.

title: Proposal model with evidence and revert path
acceptance_criteria: Every proposal carries the anomaly or fatigue event ids that justify it and a populated revert path before it can be queued.

title: Auto-approve rule engine
acceptance_criteria: Rules are scoped and USD-capped. auto_approved is recorded distinctly from human_approved, so autonomy graduation can be analyzed later.

title: Execution-time guardrail re-check
acceptance_criteria: Ceilings are re-read immediately before the HTTP call. A proposal approved Monday that violates a Wednesday ceiling returns GuardrailViolation, which is an expected outcome and not an error.

title: OptimizationWorkflow
acceptance_criteria: Proposal to guardrail re-check to mutation to verification to reversible ledger row, as one durable execution.

title: Winner scaling
acceptance_criteria: A proven creative or audience scales with explicit spend bounds and a stated expected effect.

title: Outcome attribution and learning signal write
acceptance_criteria: Each executed optimization gets a measured outcome written back as a learning signal, de-identified before any global-scope write.

title: Compound fatigue scorer
acceptance_criteria: Requires at least three simultaneous signals. Enforced in the database constraint, the event schema, and the scorer. No single-signal or time-elapsed trigger exists anywhere.

title: Format-calibrated thresholds
acceptance_criteria: Short-form video thresholds trip materially earlier than static feed, with values sourced from the Spec Registry rather than hard-coded.

title: Refresh pipeline
acceptance_criteria: Detected fatigue produces a new creative set that enters the normal approval path. Refresh is never auto-launched.

title: Fatigue backtest against alpha data
acceptance_criteria: Thresholds validated against real alpha performance history before they gate any production refresh.

title: Vertical gate
acceptance_criteria: Restricted-vertical flags per brand short-circuit the pipeline before any other stage runs.

title: Lexical and claim-pattern scanner
acceptance_criteria: Banned words and regulated-claim patterns for income, health, superlative, and guarantee language, each with a policy citation.

title: Claim substantiation as a hard block
acceptance_criteria: An unresolved claim in a generated asset blocks. It is a graph lookup, not a model judgment, so the verdict is explainable and reproducible.

title: Likeness detection and consent artifacts
acceptance_criteria: Resolves open question T4. A realistic person with no consent artifact is a hard block with Owner-only override and mandatory written justification.

title: Jurisdiction resolution
acceptance_criteria: Union of targeted geos maps to applicable disclosure regimes and the strictest wins, including EU AI Act Article 50 obligations now in force.

title: Disclosure application
acceptance_criteria: Writes a visible label layer, sets the platform AI-content flag, and attaches provenance metadata. An asset requiring a disclosure it did not receive cannot be marked compliance_pass.

title: Policy corpus store with a named owner and change SLA
acceptance_criteria: Versioned, citation-backed rules per channel with an accountable owner. A corpus bump can force re-check of everything pending in the queue.

title: Rejection intelligence loop
acceptance_criteria: A recurring rejection pattern above threshold is promoted into the corpus and into that brand's generation constraints. The corpus improves from production, not from reading changelogs.

title: Owner-only override with alerting
acceptance_criteria: Justification minimum length enforced by the database; every override alerts and appears in the audit export.

title: Compliance audit export and one clean external audit
acceptance_criteria: Beta exit requires one clean external compliance audit of the disclosure and substantiation paths.

title: Agency portfolio console
acceptance_criteria: Cross-client performance, pending approvals, and health in one view that stays usable at 60 clients.

title: White-label theming
acceptance_criteria: Agency-only, enforced by the database constraint. A business account cannot hold a white-label configuration.

title: Client portal
acceptance_criteria: client_viewer and client_approver see exactly one brand and can approve without access to anything else in the agency.

title: Cross-client reuse with explicit opt-in
acceptance_criteria: Templates and learnings cross client boundaries only on explicit opt-in. Default is full isolation per the tenancy model.

title: Per-client billing attribution
acceptance_criteria: Generation and platform cost attributable per client brand, so an agency can bill through accurately.

title: Bulk cross-client operations with per-client token scoping
acceptance_criteria: A bulk action across 20 clients issues 20 separately scoped tokens. One token can never authorize spend for a brand it was not issued for.

title: Beta exit-gate instrumentation
acceptance_criteria: Approval-accept rate and day-60 CPA delta per beta brand are live and trustworthy before the review.

title: Beta exit review
acceptance_criteria: Gate: at least 75% approval-accept rate, demonstrated CPA improvement in at least 50% of beta brands at day 60, one clean compliance audit.

title: Vertical template framework
acceptance_criteria: A template seeds objectives, channel mix, creative angles, and compliance constraints for a vertical.

title: Ten vertical templates authored and reviewed
acceptance_criteria: Each template reviewed by someone with real domain experience in that vertical, not generated and shipped.

title: Catalog and feed ingest
acceptance_criteria: Product, price, and inventory ingest with scheduled refresh and staleness detection.

title: Catalog-driven generation
acceptance_criteria: Scene graphs template over catalog rows; a thousand SKUs do not become a thousand generations.

title: Per-channel catalog ad mapping
acceptance_criteria: Catalog ad support read from the Capability Registry per channel. No channel-name branching.

title: Creative analytics at attribute level
acceptance_criteria: Performance attributable to creative attributes (hook type, format, angle), not just to ad ids.

title: ReportWorkflow with PDF render and white-label
acceptance_criteria: Scheduled weekly and monthly reports, narrated, rendered, and delivered, with agency branding where configured.

title: Methodology annotation propagation
acceptance_criteria: Annotations reach the UI and the PDF. No surface can display a blended cross-channel figure without one.

title: Resolve the analytics store decision
acceptance_criteria: Resolves open question T1 with measured cost and latency at projected volume, then executes the chosen path.

title: First-party connectors
acceptance_criteria: CRM, ecommerce, and call-tracking ingest feeding first_party_only metrics.

title: Offline conversion upload
acceptance_criteria: Per-channel offline conversion upload where the Capability Registry declares support.

title: First-party revenue as a goal metric
acceptance_criteria: The Strategist can optimize against first-party revenue instead of platform-attributed conversions.

title: Cross-channel reallocation proposals
acceptance_criteria: Reallocation reasons only over comparable metrics and states its comparability assumptions in the proposal itself.

title: ComparabilityViolation enforcement end to end
acceptance_criteria: Any caller requesting a cross-channel aggregate over caveated metrics without accepting an annotation gets a hard error. Verified from API through UI.

title: Self-serve billing and plan tiers
acceptance_criteria: Entry, growth, and scale tiers with seat and brand metering for both account types. No percent-of-spend pricing anywhere in the model.

title: Generation overage metering
acceptance_criteria: Overage billed from the same agent_run meter that drives margin-per-brand. One meter, not two.

title: Dunning and downgrade paths
acceptance_criteria: Failed payment pauses generation before it pauses live campaigns, so a billing lapse never silently wastes a client's ad spend.

title: Support tooling
acceptance_criteria: Impersonation is fully audited and visibly flagged to the user afterward. Brand health view for triage.

title: Operational runbooks and drills
acceptance_criteria: Runbooks for channel outage, quota storm, token incident, outbox backlog, and a rehearsed kill-switch drill.

title: Status page and incident comms
acceptance_criteria: Per-channel degradation is visible to customers without a human writing an update first.

title: GA readiness review
acceptance_criteria: Gate: every P0 requirement met, all nine channels at parity with zero waivers, security and compliance sign-off.
